> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Always `true`<!-- -->, use `log.level === 'silent'` instead; it  will be removed in the next major version.
>

Deprecated accessor to check the `silent` level, always `true`<!-- -->.

## Signature

```typescript
get isSilent(): boolean;
```

## Remarks

Since `silent` is the lowest level, this accessor is always `true`<!-- -->, for every level that was set, and also before a level is set (the preliminary state). It cannot tell whether the logger is silent.

To check for the `silent` level, compare the `level` accessor.

<ul> <li>changed to an accessor in v3.0.0</li> <li>deprecated in v7.0.0</li> </ul>

## Example


```javascript
if (log.level === 'silent') {
  // Nothing but `always()` messages are output.
}
```
